title: Differential compatibility of the factorwise open-restriction comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], $U$ an open of $X$, and $L,M$ arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of sheaves of modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F$ be restriction to the localized ringed site over $U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], let $L_F=F(L)$ and $M_F=F(M)$, and write $H=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,M)$ and $K=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L_F,M_F)$ [def-pur-hom-complex]. Choose the projection families $\pi$ and $\tau$ specified by [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections] on the global and localized sites. Suppose given isomorphisms $e_n:F(H^n)\to K^n$ for every integer $n$ such that for all integers $p,q$ with $p+n=q$, $e_n\tau_{n,p,q}=F(\pi_{n,p,q})c_{p,q}$, where $c_{p,q}$ is the canonical restriction isomorphism of internal sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] furnished by SheafOfModules.overHomObjIso. Then for all $n,m$ with $n+1=m$, $e_n d_K^{n,m}=F(d_H^{n,m})e_m$. This statement assumes the degreewise isomorphisms and asserts only compatibility with the differential; it constructs no isomorphisms.

proof.text: For adjacent n,m, postcompose the claimed identity with each projection tau in degree m. These projections are jointly monic because the chosen localized fan is a limit. Use the localized differential-projection formula to expand the left side into postcomposition by d_M minus n.negOnePow times precomposition by d_L. Apply the assumed projection equations to both summands.

Expand the right side using the projection equation in degree m and functoriality of restriction. Apply the global differential-projection formula. Restriction is additive since its maps are precomposed sectionwise, so it preserves subtraction and multiplication by the sign.

Apply internal Hom restriction naturality to the pre- and post-composition terms. The private categorical factor_differential calculation converts the sign unit to its integer value, distributes composition and integer scalar multiplication, rewrites the three comparison equations and the two differential formulas, and identifies the summands. Limit hom_ext proves the equality.

proof_origin.description: P2: the projection route is formalized from the existing projections theorem and the newly proved sectionwise naturality theorem. No new sorry is introduced and no unit step is bypassed.

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_restrict_open_differential (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (U : Opens X)
    (L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) :
    let F := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) U
    let LF := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L
    let MF := (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M
    let H := homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L M
    let K := homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) LF MF
    let π := Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := X.sheaf))
    let τ := Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := X.sheaf.over U))
    ∀ (e : ∀ n : ℤ, F.obj (H.X n) ≅ K.X n),
      (∀ (n p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q),
        (e n).hom ≫ τ LF MF n p q hpq =
          F.map (π L M n p q hpq) ≫
            (SheafOfModules.overHomObjIso (L.X p) (M.X q) U).hom) →
      ∀ (n m : ℤ), n + 1 = m →
        (e n).hom ≫ K.d n m = F.map (H.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom
